utility_use_case: A reliability engineer investigating a deployment can run the summary over a protected application log to compare the number of error-severity lines with lines matching a targeted pattern, without copying message bodies into a ticket. The resulting counts are a quick descriptive check, not proof that the deployment caused an incident or that every relevant event was captured.
